method: Executed deterministic JavaScript checks against connector-fetched GitHub JSON plus constructed EPSG:5179 metre-coordinate rounding boundary counterexamples; synthetic examples are not observed source features

sameNodeFarApart.meaning: Two endpoints over 10cm apart can quantize to the same node; not evidence of an observed wrong connection

differentNodesNearApart.meaning: Two endpoints ~1.414mm apart can quantize to different nodes; proximity does not establish legal or physical passage

finding: Quantization can both conflate spatially distinct endpoints and separate near-coincident endpoints. Published aggregate counts cannot identify topology errors; prioritize original feature-to-node lineage and per-edge component replay.
acceptance: For each of 114 >5cm nodes and four <=2cm cross-node pairs, obtain original SHP feature IDs, unrounded EPSG:5179 endpoints, quantized IDs and graph component membership
Verify candidate links <=35m against official trail evidence; no physical connection approved from distance alone
Independently hash source SHP, v102/v129, 3D DEM, audit ZIP; run v69 regression and deployed nationwide coverage tests
limitations: Original SHP/DEM/ZIP bytes not accessible in this run; Git blob identities only
Synthetic counterexamples do not classify any real endpoint
